info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Corporate Relation Corporate Relationship-spec
info.description: The Corporate Relationship Management API allows businesses to establish and manage relationships with corporate entities efficiently. This API enables users to create new corporate relationships, ensuring that all pertinent information is captured during the onboarding process. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and corporate banks looking to streamline their relationship management workflows. By facilitating effective interactions between businesses, the API enhances collaboration and fosters stronger corporate partnerships.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to create a new corporate relationship between entities, facilitating collaboration and partnership establishment. The request should include the necessary details for the relationship.

requestBody.description: This request body should contain the necessary information to create or update a corporate relationship. The information provided in the JSON format will be processed to establish or modify the relationship as required.

201.description: Successfully created the corporate relationship resource.
